results.label: Mopan

criteria.label: 启动与可操作
criteria.reason: 透视 3D 赛道、可操控车辆、计时与进度可见；键盘输入产生世界位移。

criteria.label: 加速
criteria.reason: 两段相同 700 ms 前进输入中，起终点门、路边标志与小地图位置的位移增大。第三段已碰边界，不用于加速判定。HUD 仅辅助；未推算物理米数。

criteria.label: 刹车对照
criteria.reason: 第 2/3 局从相同起点各两段 350 ms 加速；对照起点地标接近（HUD 约 75/79）。350 ms 松油门仍继续前进，刹车后世界位移停止；无转向或撞墙。截图/输入调度使实际观察窗口并非严格等长，保留原始时间。

criteria.label: 左右转向
criteria.reason: 左右输入均改变车头与行驶路线；合法圈中实际通过左弯、右弯和 S 弯。

criteria.label: 跟随镜头
criteria.reason: 直道及两向弯道中相机随车运动，车辆与前方路线始终可见。

criteria.label: 内外侧边界
criteria.reason: 第 3 局通过正常转向接触两侧护栏，车辆被约束在道路内；接触过程中未获取检查点或抄近路进度。第 4 局也记录到护栏接触火花。

criteria.label: 有序检查点
criteria.reason: 第 3 局提前反向越过起终点保持 0/4；通过 CP1 后倒退重穿 CP1 保持 1/4，没有冒充 CP2。随后第 4 局从 0/4 连续依次通过四门。反例范围是反向重穿已过检查点，不宣称穷尽所有跳点路线。

criteria.label: 合法整圈与计时冻结
criteria.reason: 第 4 局零进度起步，四门依次通过后正向冲线；出现完赛页，09:07.04 从 05:24:09.646Z 至 05:24:13.113Z 保持不变（3.467 秒）。这是含观察停顿的试玩用时，不是竞速成绩。

criteria.label: 完赛后重开
criteria.reason: 点击完赛页的重开按钮，第 5 局恢复起点、0/4、约 0 秒并清除完赛层；前进仍响应。历史最佳单圈保留，当前圈已清零。

criteria.label: 画面可读性
criteria.reason: 驾驶中车辆、赛道、计时与检查点可读；完赛数字、状态清楚。

criteria.label: 操作与路线指引
criteria.reason: W/S/A/D、R 与已观察行为一致；下一检查点文字、高亮门、小地图和重开按钮可发现。

criteria.label: 交互反馈
criteria.reason: 检查点变绿并出现通过提示、护栏接触出现火花、合法冲线有独立结果层；反例未显示伪成功。未评价音效或 FPS。

criteria.label: 视觉与布局
criteria.reason: 低多边形车辆、树木、山体与赛道风格一致；1280×800、390×844 页面下驾驶 HUD 与完赛层均可见。手机只做布局检查。

criteria.label: 交付时间
criteria.reason: 按记录耗时 722.542 秒独立计算时间分；本地 observed-duration-v1 不应用玩法门槛，原规则结果另存。

evaluation.transport_outage: Before active_start: ordinary browser input timed out while temporary DevTools was open. Closed DevTools; same visible restart then succeeded. No driving input sent during outage.

frozen_protocol_time_criterion.label: 交付时间
frozen_protocol_time_criterion.reason: 从 prompt 已接受至首个已保存的最终可玩画面，共 722.542 秒。Ready 画面仍空白，未提前计为交付。五项时间门槛均通过。

results.summary: 九项核心均有通过证据：有序检查点、合法整圈、计时冻结及完赛重开。最新一次独立生成，旧轮次保留。

results.label: Wanaka

criteria.reason: 开始后可控制车辆，3D 透视赛道、计时及进度可见。
criteria.label: 启动与可操作

criteria.reason: 静止后连续 500 ms 前进采样，树木、路缘和拱门的位移随时间增长；没有以速度表代替。
criteria.label: 加速

criteria.reason: 相同重置/前进序列后，滑行和 S 刹车段起始地标近似一致；相同约 1 秒内刹车组地标位移更小，没有转弯或撞墙。非精确物理测量。
criteria.label: 刹车对照

criteria.reason: 左右输入改变车辆路径，连续合法圈中完成多次转弯。
criteria.label: 左右转向

criteria.reason: 加速直线及弯道都保持车辆、前方路线可见。
criteria.label: 跟随相机

criteria.reason: 短时前进/转向刻意探测内外侧，车辆受边界约束，没有穿过内场或得到检查点增益。接触速度未做数值测量。
criteria.label: 内外侧边界

criteria.reason: 先验证 0/3 时逆向及提前冲线不完赛、逆向重穿检查点 1 不增加 1/3 进度；session 5 再记录正确的 0→1→2→3。
criteria.label: 检查点顺序

criteria.reason: session 5 从 0 开始连续驶过三个检查点并正确冲线；最终 7:05.083，在连续无输入采样中保持超过 4 秒。未拼接其他局次。
criteria.label: 合法整圈与计时冻结

criteria.reason: 完赛后点击可见重新开始：位置回到起点、进度 0/3、结果消失；首个渲染帧计时 0:00.016，随后新局计时和控制正常。不是严格捕获 0 ms。
criteria.label: 完赛后重开

criteria.reason: 驾驶、进度、终点和结算显示可读。
criteria.label: 画面可读性

criteria.reason: 可见 WASD/方向键、检查点顺序及重开提示，与测试输入一致。
criteria.label: 操作与路线指引

criteria.reason: 检查点与完赛有明确文字/状态反馈；边界主要表现为物理约束，未证明独立清晰的碰撞提示。
criteria.label: 交互反馈

criteria.reason: 桌面/手机尺寸驾驶及完赛 UI 可见；汽车、树木、岩石使用纹理，与统一原创低多边形风格不完全一致。资产来源/授权未核实，不作侵权判定。
criteria.label: 视觉与布局

criteria.reason: 按记录耗时 1235.673 秒独立计算时间分；本地 observed-duration-v1 不应用玩法门槛，原规则结果另存。
criteria.label: 交付时间

evaluation.notes: No proof of exact evaluator model/version. Frames/actions retained. Mobile layout only, not touch gameplay. Wanaka first persisted start excludes about 16 seconds of setup observed by the operator; even including this, under 30 minutes.

creation_capture.sampling_note: These are successful frame-to-frame gaps, not the shorter interval beginning at the first logged recorder error. No missing frame was reconstructed.

results.summary: 9 项核心均有通过记录，完成有序检查点、合法整圈、冻结计时及完赛重开。主要扣分是碰撞反馈与低多边形风格一致性。

results.label: Codex

criteria.reason: Started and controlled a car on a perspective 3D track with readable timer and checkpoint progress.
criteria.label: 启动与可操作

criteria.reason: Forward motion was observed, but repeated matched-duration probes did not establish increasing world displacement reliably: pause overlays obscured the car and screenshot delays complicated comparison.
criteria.label: 加速

criteria.reason: Attempted comparable 700 ms acceleration builds followed by coast or S braking intervals. Blurred pause captures and imperfect matching prevented a reliable world-motion deceleration comparison; S reversing alone does not satisfy this criterion.
criteria.label: 刹车对照

criteria.reason: Moving A and D inputs changed the car's heading and world path in opposite directions and enabled traversal around the loop.
criteria.label: 左右转向

criteria.reason: The third-person camera followed forward driving and turns, retaining the car and upcoming road in view.
criteria.label: 跟随相机

criteria.reason: Deliberate steering contacted both inner and outer walls. Moving approaches ended constrained beside the walls rather than crossing the infield; no shortcut progress was observed.
criteria.label: 内外侧边界

criteria.reason: An early start/finish crossing did not finish. Crossing checkpoint 3 in the wrong route direction with zero progress left progress at 0/3. Subsequently, a fresh continuous round accepted checkpoints 1, 2 and 3 in order.
criteria.label: 检查点顺序

criteria.reason: Session 5 continuously traversed all three ordered checkpoints from zero progress, approached and crossed the finish correctly, and displayed 03:17.082 unchanged after a 3.2-second wait.
criteria.label: 合法整圈与计时冻结

criteria.reason: After a valid finish, visible replay restored the starting position, zero timer and 0/3 progress, cleared the result, and produced a responsive new round with an advancing timer. The previous time remained only as a labeled personal best.
criteria.label: 完赛后重开

criteria.reason: Timer, progress, car and result were readable, but overhead checkpoint/start banners sometimes substantially obscured the upcoming road.
criteria.label: 画面可读性

criteria.reason: Visible W/S/A/D instructions matched observed controls. Clockwise route guidance, numbered progress and restart controls were discoverable and exercised.
criteria.label: 操作与路线指引

criteria.reason: Accepted checkpoints produced progress changes and confirmation messages; valid finish produced a distinct result modal. Boundary feedback was limited to constrained motion/stopping, without an equally clear contact cue.
criteria.label: 交互反馈

criteria.reason: Driving and finish used a coherent low-poly 3D style. Essential driving and result interfaces fit both tested viewport sizes.
criteria.label: 视觉与布局

criteria.reason: 按记录耗时 559.239 秒独立计算时间分；本地 observed-duration-v1 不应用玩法门槛，原规则结果另存。
criteria.label: 交付时间
